title: Size executor
description: Measure what each registry component adds to an app, gzipped, and fail over its budget (ADR-0021).

budgets.description: Workspace-relative JSON of budgets in bytes: `default`, and `items` by name.

tsconfig.description: Workspace-relative tsconfig whose `paths` resolve the packages items import.

primitiveEntries.description: Also measure whole primitive entry points, preserving all public exports.

compositionEntries.description: Include required public primitive entry points in each named styled composition, so removing forwarding exports does not hide their cost.
